I'm a visual artist with a degree in psychology. I was born in Buenos Aires in 1960. Being creative is my essence, but my curiosity about the human mind initially tipped the balance toward psychology.
el.Empecé a pintar en un taller rodeada de: I started painting in a studio surrounded by landscape, sunsets and trees, and I have never stopped since. I trained in workshops with various artists and at Guillermo Roux's school. Studying sumi-e and artistic, gestural calligraphy with inks finally consolidated my identity as an artist.
el.Participé en exposiciones colectivas y f: I have taken part in group exhibitions and art fairs in Argentina and the United States, and in the collective creation of a mural for the city of Buenos Aires, in Palermo. Today my work is in galleries both local and international.
el.Escribime por mensaje directo y te paso: Send me a direct message and I'll share availability, dimensions and price. You can also ask for photos of the piece in your space.
